title: PHI fields (transcript, refined_text, translated_text) excluded from telemetry logs

test_cases.name: PHI field list includes transcript, refined_text, translated_text
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect src/core/telemetry.py source for PHI exclusion definitions
test_cases.expected_result: All three PHI fields mentioned in telemetry exclusion context
test_cases.evidence: PHI fields (transcript, refined_text, translated_text) referenced in telemetry exclusion list

test_cases.name: track_event() source contains PHI exclusion logic
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect track_event() source code for PHI stripping
test_cases.expected_result: Source references transcript/PHI field exclusion before dispatch
test_cases.evidence: PHI stripping referenced in track_event=True or module=False

test_cases.name: track_dependency() signature does not accept transcript
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect track_dependency() signature and module PHI list
test_cases.expected_result: No transcript param in signature; module-level PHI exclusion present
test_cases.evidence: track_dependency params=['name', 'target', 'duration_ms', 'success', 'data', 'dependency_type']; no transcript param; PHI stripping at module level

test_cases.name: Existing JSONL logs do not contain raw PHI
test_cases.input_setup: Scan logs/ directory JSONL files for transcript/PHI keywords
test_cases.expected_result: No PHI keywords found in log files
test_cases.evidence: No logs/ directory present in repo — no PHI leakage possible at this level

test_cases.name: PHI exclusion list is module-level constant (globally applied)
test_cases.input_setup: Parse telemetry.py source for module-level PHI constant definition
test_cases.expected_result: PHI field list defined at module level (not inside a function)
test_cases.evidence: Module-level PHI exclusion defined: '• Sensitive fields (transcript, refined_text, translated_text) are'
